# Liverpool Emergency Plumber

> 24/7 emergency plumbing, gas and heating across Liverpool and Merseyside. A team of Gas Safe registered engineers led by James. Phone 0151 558 0334, answered 24 hours a day. Rated 5.0 from 53 Google reviews.

## Key facts

- Business: Liverpool Emergency Plumber, 29 Park Road, Kirkby, Merseyside L32 2AL
- Phone: 0151 558 0334 (24/7)
- Website: https://liverpoolemergencyplumber.co.uk/
- Areas: every Liverpool postcode, the Wirral, Sefton (including Formby, Crosby, Bootle, Southport, Maghull), Knowsley (Huyton, Kirkby) and St Helens
- Engineers: Gas Safe registered; all engineers G3 unvented qualified
- Labour rates: £80 an hour weekdays 9am to 5pm, £120 an hour weekends 9am to 1pm, £150 an hour out of hours. One-hour minimum, no call-out fee
- Boiler fault diagnosis: £95. Boiler service: £120. Power flush: from £350
- Workmanship guarantee: 12 months. Public liability insurance: £2m
- Payment: fixed written price before work starts. No finance offered

## New boiler packages (fixed price, fully fitted, including VAT)

Combi boiler swap, Liverpool and Merseyside. Every package includes a smart thermostat, magnetic filter, system clean, carbon monoxide alarm, Gas Safe certificate, manufacturer registration and removal of the old boiler. Free survey and written fixed price before work starts. Full details: https://liverpoolemergencyplumber.co.uk/boiler-installation-liverpool

- Essential, Baxi 600 Combi 2 (24 or 30kW): £2,195. 7-year manufacturer warranty. Best for flats, small terraces and rental homes
- Value, Baxi 800 Combi 2 (24 or 30kW): £2,495. 10-year warranty, magnetic filter in the box. Best for 2 to 3 bed homes if you are staying put
- Most popular, Worcester Bosch Greenstar 4000 (25 or 30kW): £2,695. Up to 10-year warranty. Best for most 2 to 4 bed homes
- Premium, Vaillant ecoTEC plus (826 or 832): £2,995. Up to 10-year warranty. Best for busier homes and two bathrooms
- Flagship, Worcester Bosch Greenstar 8000+ Style (32kW): £3,295. Up to 12-year warranty. Best for larger homes or a boiler on show in the kitchen
- Next size up: +£200. Ideal Logic Max available on request: £2,695
- Extras: move the boiler in the same room £450, to another room £750, to another floor £850; swap a tank system for a combi +£695
- System and regular boilers: priced after a free survey
